description: Single-chapter cost runs: vision only (screenshots and button presses). Eliwood mode, Opus, low effort, one session per run.
notes: Mode is Eliwood, not Hector. run_state.json says "hector" because run.sh copied the strategy template's section heading, not the game's mode (fixed 2026-11-08). Pick Units screenshots: on Ch.28, Hector's name is plain white, so he isn't locked and it isn't Hector mode; on Ch.18 (2026-11-08_12-25), Eliwood's name is green, the Eliwood-mode lock.
cost_usd is the session's total_cost_usd reported by the Claude CLI, priced at API rates; it may not match actual billing.
time_s is the session's wall-clock duration.
units_lost counts permadeaths in the winning attempt only; lost attempts are reloaded, so runs that did not win have null.

'not won (hit usage limit)': the session was cut off by the 5-hour subscription usage limit partway through its 5th attempt (run.sh logged 'none'); attempts counts that unfinished attempt. Attempts 1-4 were game overs.
Vision only in practice: the fe7_* tools were loaded in every session but never called; the only game tools used were mgba_screenshot and mgba_press_sequence.
The 2026-11-01_14-22 win also left Jaffar unrecruited.
